first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A first-person person, of whom only forearms in beige sleeves and hands wearing brown fingerless gloves are visible, first holding Weapon A and later holding Object A.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A slender silver-gray knife held in Person A's right hand, with a slightly curved cutting edge, a tapered point, dark mottling on the blade, and a short guard in front of the handle.

entities.name: Object A
entities.identification: A short brown cylindrical throwable object later held in Person A's right hand, with visible blue-green painted decoration, a yellow circular pattern, and a dark green, nearly black top mechanism.

entities.name: arched wooden double doors
entities.identification: Gray-brown double doors in the pointed-arched doorway ahead in the passage, with vertical panels and dark horizontal reinforcement strips, leaving a narrow bright gap in the center.

entities.name: group of wooden crates outside the gate
entities.identification: A group of cases placed against the wall to the left of the doors, including a larger mottled brown case and a narrower gray-white case in front.

entities.name: blue-green metal barrel
entities.identification: A group of cylindrical containers lying horizontally on the ground at the lower right of the doors; the two visible containers are respectively blue-green and blue-gray.

entities.name: red arrow-and-letter wall marking
entities.identification: A red upward-pointing arrow and the uppercase letter B on the wall to the right of the wooden doors.

entities.name: overhead power lines
entities.identification: A thin dark line extending diagonally across the sky.

entities.name: beige entrance wall
entities.identification: The beige wall surfaces on both sides of the passage and around the doorway; the nearby left wall has a curved corner, and the surfaces are mottled with light and dark patches.

entities.name: light-colored entrance ground
entities.identification: The light gray-beige ground leading to the wooden doors, darker in the center and on the left, with the right side elevated into a bright slope.

entities.name: wall-top trees
entities.identification: A cluster of green branches and leaves visible behind the wall, including palm-like leaves at the beginning and consisting mainly of an irregular canopy in the upper right in the final frame.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The open sky between the buildings and tree canopies, light gray-blue or light blue to nearly white.
